description: Validates a Polyxd UI document and shows it to the user as an interactive screen, drawn by the Polyxd renderer in the design-system pack you choose (default material3). Shows nothing if the document has errors; fix them first with polyxd_validate. When the user presses an action in the screen, you receive a chat message from the user naming the action and its context; that only tells you their choice, and nothing has been submitted or paid. Packs: material3, antd, bootstrap, carbon, chakra, fluent, govuk, mantine, polaris, primer, radix, shadcn, spectrum, brutalist, civic, editorial, finance, glass, health, mono, neon, pastel, sketch, terminal, wireframe.

data.description: The values the screen shows, bound by {"path": "/pointer"}. Replaces the document's own "data" when given.

document.description: A Polyxd UI document: {specVersion, surface, root, components, data?}. polyxd_guide explains the format.

mode.description: Light or dark. Leave out to follow the host's theme.

pack.description: The design-system pack to draw the screen in, by id: material3, antd, bootstrap, carbon, chakra, fluent, govuk, mantine, polaris, primer, radix, shadcn, spectrum, brutalist, civic, editorial, finance, glass, health, mono, neon, pastel, sketch, terminal, wireframe. Names like "Carbon" or "shadcn/ui" work too. Pass it whenever the user names a design system. Default material3.

name: polyxd_show

outputSchema.description: shown is true with the document, pack and spec version when the screen was shown; false with the issues when it was not (that result is also an error).

document.description: The Polyxd UI document as shown, with the separately passed data merged in as its "data". The MCP App renders it.

issues.description: When not shown: the document's errors and warnings, each at its JSON Pointer with a hint.

component.description: The component the pointer is inside, when it is inside one.

hint.description: What to change to fix it, when there is a known fix.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the problem in the document, e.g. "/components/2/label".

severity.description: "error" must be fixed before the document is shown; "warning" is advice.

mode.description: Light or dark, when one was asked for. Absent: the screen follows the host's theme.

pack.description: The design-system pack the screen is drawn in.

shown.description: Whether the screen was shown to the user. False when the document has errors.

specVersion.description: The version of the Polyxd spec this server implements, e.g. "0.3.0". Documents set it as their "specVersion".

title: Show a Polyxd screen
